name: Orcs and Outlaws
detailed_description:
A classic action adventure shooter, featuring the blonde bounty hunter Ava Velkovira versus a horde of super Orcs and their army of the undead:

- A new generation of Orc warriors

- Their army of dragons, demons and the undead

- A badass blonde bounty hunter

- Melee, spell casting and shooting combat

Key Features:

ORCS, VAMPIRES, DEMONS AND MORE

The bounty hunters have been getting reports and rumors of bizarre and fearsome creatures roaming remote regions in the world. They include visions of dragons, giants and animals never seen before. Whatever’s there, its worth the risk for an Orc bounty.

Demon spirits - malevolent entities believed to possess supernatural powers

The world of sun demons where chaos and suffering reign supreme

Infernal knights - formidable warriors of the demonic realm

Fight against brutish Orcs with skin as thick as armour

THIRD PERSON ACTION ADVENTURE

You must use a combination of stealth, speed, and stamina to explore each Orc stronghold. Mixing classic third person shooting gameplay with exciting exploration, fluid and fast movement is crucial to your success.

FANTASY DARK ENVIRONMENTS AND LANDSCAPES

The demonic strongholds are hidden in abandoned military bases, cloaked castles ancient ruins. Navigate your way through each challenging and complex Orc fortress to find its hidden secrets. You will need to constantly scan your surroundings and work out how to gain access to the inner sanctums and connecting gateway portals.  

THIRD PERSON SHOOTING, MAGIC AND MELEE COMBAT

You will have access to a arsenal of specialized arms and fantasy weapons. Starting with your bare fists, you will need to search the ruins for additional weaponry that has been hidden. Knives, swords, rifles, pistols, powerful spells and more will all be at your disposal… if you can find them. Weapons and ammunition will always be scarce. Be careful and choose your battles wisely.

BACKGROUND

They always exited. Before human time could be measured, Orcs thrived in the darkness. Led astray by the Dark Lords in the genesis wars, they survived the centuries by becoming independent.

Unseen and undetectable, they grew in strength, joining forces with demons and the undead. Cloaked by mystical screens, they were protected from humans and their mechanized armies.

Aware of the their growing ethereal abilities, the kingdoms of man declared Orcs and their rogue spirits as outlaws. Orcs were hunted by the Protectorate, an ancient order of hunters. Only Protectorate bounty hunters could enter the cloaked Orc strongholds

Ava Velkovira leads the last remaining bounty unit.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7
  • Processor: Intel i3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated HD Graphics Card
  • Storage: 128 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce 8GB

content_descriptors.notes: As a 3D shooting game, it contains imagery and animations of human characters getting harmed and shot. Though not realistic violence (compared to movies), it would not be suitable for children or any other young person who has not played similar games. An equivalent movie rating would be PG13.
